newsitem.title: USA: Perma-Fix says Class A warrants to expire.
newsitem.headline: Perma-Fix says Class A warrants to expire.

text.p: Perma-Fix Environmental Services Inc said Tuesday that its Class A warrants will expire on December 7, 1996. It does not plan to extend the warrants.

The company said it has been told by Nasdaq that the Class A warrants would not continue to be listed on the Nasdaq SmallCap Market after November 6 because there are not two active market makers for the Class A warrants.
After November 6, the warrants may be traded in the OTC pink sheets, it said.
Perma-Fix provides hazardous, mixed and industrial waste management services, as well as environmental engineering and consulting services.
